title: Value of External Untreated versus Treatment-Hidden Outcome Cohorts for Pointwise CATE Estimation
banked_reason: Sound all-budget two-source frontier, but below field floor: paper_score_ceiling 7 < 7.4; Not salvageable within scope.
gap_reasons: Its reach is limited to one fixed smoothness configuration, two covariate coordinates, exact known uniform design, and pointwise exclusion of V from the treatment effect.
Total computability supplies no computational-cost or finite-sample performance guarantee, so the pretraining and causal-forest connections remain motivations rather than delivered applications.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived both all-budget source-information minimax maps, total attaining estimators, and the exact-eta obstruction. The mathematical panel passed with no findings and the Hoeffding citation was independently attested, but scope and implementation limits held the achieved tier at subfield below the field floor. No Lean formalization was started; no bounded improvement remained, and the independent terminal-validity check confirmed downgraded banking.
tldr: For the causal subgroup target \(\theta(P)=t(1/2)\), external untreated outcomes and treatment-hidden factual outcomes have different sharp minimax value on one complete observational class. With rough two-coordinate assignment and baseline prognosis and a Lipschitz one-coordinate effect, the all-budget absolute-risk orders are \(\rho_{\mathrm M}(n,m)=n^{-2/13}\) and \(\rho_{\mathrm B}(n,m)=\max\{n^{-1/3},\min\{n^{-2/13},(m+1)^{-1/3}\}\}\). Baseline borrowing has elbows at \(m+1\asymp n^{6/13}\) and \(m+1\asymp n\), and restores one-dimensional regression-oracle order exactly under eventually linear-or-larger auxiliary growth. Factual outcomes cannot restore that order, even when their entire regression \(\eta\) is supplied exactly. Total original-record procedures attain both maps, and same-class all-procedure converses hold at every finite budget.
gap: Inspected CATE pretraining, higher-order minimax and augmented-trial results do not give a common-class comparison of baseline and treatment-hidden factual outcomes for every primary and auxiliary budget.
fill: The complete two-channel risk map is derived from continuous localized pair moments and jointly mixed original-record likelihoods, with public total procedures and necessary and sufficient oracle-restoration conditions.
